data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=3MQJ9Axm59MQ7kNvgGkcBpg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCT13DjxlA7h5blGI4gU7agryzRyvJ4464AAUdv9OaaBg&oe=67518F1C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Hdfa-k-DT-oQ7kNvgE5yMxF&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCw8Ek2_EEUyhRct5Ph4PVCvGzc0BDJPm-Ce91_2iLRjg&oe=675198A4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=sGkc-mIwWqoQ7kNvgEh4oMg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDi4RpDd7pUP8S9NZXM_fL2XI4JC9Tc7sLs2fx5j3T_jA&oe=67518007)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=2Q_UruKwwxAQ7kNvgE5fKfZ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDAsX6FU4xZCr2QAU36u0HNVZzjf2L8Ekdt5vGRTwRnbA&oe=675172E6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=d6cXMZePeWMQ7kNvgHBvmEv&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBpSA9Pzk12FMLsVsgdTVlitJlEzdYFBja6V9zGVWZJjg&oe=67519F58)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iHFZhBKlGvsQ7kNvgGmzGV4&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAXo0CmTcrbsLzco8sXZThjW31ZIclPf5Gu92zY8ae2hg&oe=67519BD9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_rXepc1B-lsQ7kNvgFRl6PI&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDqrzB2IJz6K8FMkajq9UZApVhQhDa4C-bi-BY_d2jO3w&oe=675181F0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=laXJlHpUIdMQ7kNvgG_TAmw&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBXI09aV-hn-goz81C1PKay3eCuTNl0OXh-lMh9vlgqHQ&oe=6751A4AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Im89b6Curx4Q7kNvgH1fmsg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYASxCeha-vxvu77iUIGh2Jf99u228AwIqIz830i0VKwYg&oe=67518017)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ppGD3C4nOzoQ7kNvgF7Myri&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBrWvy59aZ1mOVKVZ2YWbQw4vegHr8xbZVBeNaSg0ij8A&oe=67519B8C)
